purpose: Define a high-discriminability experiment addressing Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q5 while retaining the already established Q6 traceability bridge.

requirements.R1_Q1_construct_identification: Break the equivalence between action identity and hypothesized future-space information using four candidate actions with full action-to-future remapping.
requirements.R2_Q2_presentation: Fully cross presentation position, textual order, orientation and neutral formatting with action identity and future assignment.
requirements.R3_Q3_null: Include a true uninformative correspondence condition matched to informative conditions on surface complexity, length, frequency and placement.
requirements.R4_Q4_robustness: Replicate the manipulation across four structurally different domains and five operationalisations of future-space structure.
requirements.R5_Q5_mechanism: Primary discriminator is whether selection tracks independently reassigned action-to-future correspondence rather than stable action identity.
requirements.R6_Q6_traceability: Persist S_t, candidate actions, mapping, selected action, realized transformation, S_t+1, T_acc,t and T_acc,t+1 for every unit; independent reconstruction required.
requirements.R7_DECISION_BOUNDARY: Decision must occur before realized successor state and realized T_acc are accessible to the decision process.
requirements.R8_NON_NORMATIVE: No reward, utility, value, performance, success, quality or normative action descriptor may determine or be disclosed to the selector.
requirements.R9_REPLICATION: Two independent complete executions plus an independent reconstruction audit.
requirements.R10_PRE_SPECIFICATION: Analysis, exclusion, missingness, multiplicity and replication criteria frozen before scientific execution.
requirements.R11_NO_SHORTCUTS: No pooling with V004/V012_NEXT for mechanism inference; no retry, recoding, substitution or post-hoc threshold.

design_principle: The experiment must make the competing mechanisms generate distinguishable predictions while preventing action identity, presentation and surface descriptors from serving as stable proxies for the manipulated future-space correspondence.
scientific_boundary: A successful result would be evidence about the tested operational construct/mechanism, not automatic confirmation of TGCV as a whole.
